topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I found the bouquet on my doorstep this morning, wrapped in brown paper, no card. The petals were so vibrant, yet as I delved into the mystery, I couldn’t shake the weight of the unsaid. Who would send such a gesture and not claim it? I tried to retrace my steps, think of interactions, moments where a kind word might have sparked more than I realized. Each memory brought a whisper of a face, a smile, a nod in passing. But no clear answer. I should reach out, make inquiries, yet I linger, the unexplained gesture a silent reproach, a question I dread to answer.
